    Still to decide

    1. Name & domain

      Is this a club handle, a subdomain, or both? Which names are reserved, and can people rename them?

    2. Signal & account access

      A Signal invite may suggest a profile; a one-time confirmation proves ownership. Decide how Authentik links that identity, how the bridge issues challenges, and how someone recovers a lost account. Bridge access and hosting are still pending.

    3. Agreement

      The club currently links to the Berlin Code of Conduct. Confirm which policy version is accepted, who receives reports, and whether an approval step is needed.

    4. Notifications

      Which teams need opt-in lists? This version offers event announcements by email or Signal. No group is joined automatically.

    5. Membership

      The amounts are examples. Confirm pricing, recurrence, cancellation, receipts, and whether payment creates any additional permissions.

    6. Order & minimum information

      This version requests an email only when Signal is unlinked or email announcements are selected. Email and Signal confirmations are simulated; decide the real verification and consent records before connecting services.

    Reference: NELA’s current community principles.
